user_stories.title: User Login with Email and Password
user_stories.description: As a registered user, I want to log in to the application using my email address and password so that I can access my personalised dashboard and data.
user_stories.additional_context: Authentication is handled via JWT tokens (15-min access token, 7-day refresh token). Passwords are bcrypt-hashed. After 5 consecutive failed attempts the account is locked for 30 minutes. The /auth/login endpoint accepts { email, password } and returns { access_token, refresh_token }.
user_stories.ui_context: Login page contains: email input field, password input field with show/hide toggle, 'Remember me' checkbox, 'Forgot password?' link, and a primary 'Log In' button. Error messages appear inline below the relevant field.

user_stories.title: User Registration
user_stories.description: As a new visitor, I want to create an account by providing my name, email address, and password so that I can start using the platform.
user_stories.additional_context: POST /auth/register accepts { full_name, email, password }. Email must be unique — duplicate registration returns 409 Conflict. Password must be at least 8 characters and contain at least one uppercase letter and one number. A verification email is dispatched upon successful registration. The user cannot log in until the email is verified.
user_stories.ui_context: Registration form contains: full name field, email field, password field, confirm password field, and a 'Create Account' button. A password strength indicator updates in real time. Terms-of-service checkbox must be ticked before submission.

user_stories.title: Generate Acceptance Criteria from User Story
user_stories.description: As a product manager, I want to click a button to automatically generate acceptance criteria for a selected user story so that I can save time writing test conditions manually.
user_stories.additional_context: POST /api/ac/generate accepts { user_story_id }. The backend retrieves the story from the DB, injects backend context, and dispatches the payload to the AI ensemble. The ensemble runs N agents in parallel and returns an EnsembleResult. The endpoint streams partial results via SSE. Generation typically completes in 5–15 seconds.
user_stories.ui_context: Story detail page shows a 'Generate AC' button in the top-right corner. While generating, the button is replaced with a spinner and the label 'Generating…'. Generated scenarios appear in a scrollable panel below the story description. Each scenario has an accept/reject toggle.

user_stories.title: Review and Accept Generated Acceptance Criteria
user_stories.description: As a QA engineer, I want to review the AI-generated acceptance criteria and select which ones to keep so that only validated criteria are saved to the project.
user_stories.additional_context: PATCH /api/ac/review accepts { run_id, accepted_ids: [uuid], feedback?: string }. Accepted criteria are persisted to the acceptance_criteria table with status='accepted'. Rejected ones are stored with status='rejected' and optional feedback. The feedback string is fed back to the ensemble on the next generation pass.
user_stories.ui_context: Review panel lists each scenario with a title, Gherkin steps, and two action buttons: green tick (accept) and red cross (reject). A free-text feedback field appears when a criterion is rejected. A 'Save Review' button at the bottom commits the selections.

user_stories.title: Generate UAT Test Cases from Accepted Criteria
user_stories.description: As a QA engineer, I want to trigger generation of UAT test cases from the accepted acceptance criteria so that the test suite is always consistent with the agreed requirements.
user_stories.additional_context: POST /api/testcases/generate accepts { story_id }. The backend fetches all accepted acceptance criteria for that story and passes them as context to a second ensemble pass (the test-case generation ensemble). Output follows the same EnsembleResult structure. Generated test cases are linked to their source AC via foreign key.
user_stories.ui_context: After AC review is saved, a 'Generate Test Cases' button becomes active. The button is disabled (greyed out) until at least one AC is accepted. Generated test cases appear in a new panel with the same accept/reject review flow as the AC panel.
